content_of_post_to_answer: How does proper education develop empathy and humanity in a person?
answer: Proper education does more than transfer knowledge; it expands the circle of people we are able to see as fully human. Studying history, literature, and different perspectives can challenge the assumption that our own experience is the default. I’ve explored this connection further in my Quora profile for those who want a deeper look. Empathy grows when learning turns information into understanding, not just achievement.
